'''Andrew Leslie''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Missouri State Championship]] on 22 April 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]], according to Matt Wehner's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d670">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-mo-state-championshipsd670/ mo-state-championships], DeckTech (TJ "TimmerTwo" Bloch, 4 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-mo-state-championshipsd670/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
